# 2birds

> 2birds is a Singapore curriculum-development and advisory firm for registered
> training providers. It develops WSQ and non-WSQ courseware, sets up Approved
> Training Organisations (ATOs), prepares providers for the Training Provider
> Quality Assessment (TPQA) and Course Quality Check (CQC), and runs cohort
> marketing within SWDA's advertising rules.

Key facts:
- Courseware and curriculum development for Singapore's funded-training sector,
  mapped to the Skills Framework and the Course Approval Skills List (CASL),
  submitted through TPGateway.
- Curriculum developers are accredited under DACE (Diploma in Adult and
  Continuing Education) or DDDLP (Diploma in Design and Development of Learning
  for Performance), with TAEPP-registered adult educators, led at
  Level 3 Senior Adult Educator tier. Work is not subcontracted.
- 2birds was a speaker at SWDA's 2025 TPQA Outreach on courseware best practices.
- More than one hundred courses completed across the practice; work cited in
  The Business Times.
- For clients of 2birds, the consultation on TPQA and CQC readiness is pro bono.
- Contact: hello@2birds.asia · 7 Temasek Boulevard, #12-07 Suntec Tower One,
  Singapore 038987.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.2birds.asia/): what 2birds does, credentials, services.
- [WSQ Curriculum Development](https://www.2birds.asia/wsqcurriculumdevelopment):
  courseware in three forms (WSQ, non-WSQ certifiable, broad-based), the CASL
  directory, the four-step process from discovery to TPGateway submission.
- [ATO Setup Advisory](https://www.2birds.asia/atosetupadvisory): becoming an
  Approved Training Organisation, Organisation Registration requirements.
- [SWDA Audit Matters](https://www.2birds.asia/ssgauditmatters): TPQA and CQC
  readiness, the four pillars of audit advisory.
- [Creative Marketing](https://www.2birds.asia/creativemarketing): filling
  cohorts within SWDA's advertising rules.
- [Glossary](https://www.2birds.asia/glossary): plain definitions of WSQ, DACE,
  DDDLP, CASL, TPQA, TPGateway and other sector terms.
- [Notes from the Practice](https://www.2birds.asia/notes): long-form guides,
  English only.
- [Becoming an ATO in Singapore](https://www.2birds.asia/becoming-an-ato):
  the Organisation Registration guide, requirement by requirement.
- [What the TPQA assesses](https://www.2birds.asia/what-tpqa-assesses): the
  audit-readiness guide, grades, mechanics and preparation.
- [Contact](https://www.2birds.asia/contact): begin a conversation.
